t.117: An association born in the neighbourhood
t.118: In 2008 we started out as a Saturday-afternoon leisure space in Zona Nord, Ciutat Meridiana. Eight years later, seeing neighbourhood families' needs, Associació Educació i Lleure Ubuntu was born: “I am because you are”.
t.119: We are a team of dedicated professionals and volunteers. Thanks to the community, Ubuntu grows year after year and reaches more children and families.
